deck_title: Enterprise Brand IP, Mascot & Product LoRA Training Data Hygiene Workbench: DINOv2 Near-Duplicate Pruning + Trigger-Token Caption Disentanglement + Masked Loss (c_lora = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Uncurated Dataset Concept Bleeding

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Brand LoRA Training Data Hygiene evaluation (pruning >0.92 near-duplicate burst frames via DINOv2 cosine clustering, isolating foreground subjects via BiRefNet alpha masks, disentangling variable outfit/pose/background attributes from the invariant brand trigger token, applying foreground-masked diffusion loss, and selecting checkpoints on the DINO-Identity vs CLIP-Editability Pareto frontier so amortized R&D cost c_lora(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_lora = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive uncurated dataset training (which bakes studio tables and props into the trigger token and petrifies poses, inflating H100 retraining cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-cluster manifold quadrature.
